name: Planning Center
description: Connect Planning Center to Claude to interact with your ministry data through natural conversation. Each user connects with their own account, so Claude only sees what their Planning Center permissions allow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Planning Center to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Planning Center to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.planningcenteronline.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Planning Center MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planning Center lists 37 MCP tools, including groups_event_attendances, groups_events, groups_group_types, groups_memberships, groups_search, people_background_checks, people_church_campuses, people_current_organization, people_field_data, people_field_definitions, people_form_fields, and people_form_submissions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Planning Center?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Planning Center in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Planning Center MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planning Center requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Planning Center is developed by Planning Center. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
